enrollments.title: Enrollments
enrollments.subtitle: Which student sits in which class, for every academic year

transferDialog.title: Transfer {{name}}
transferDialog.message: The current enrollment is closed as transferred and a new one is created, so the full path through the school stays visible.

withdrawDialog.title: End the enrollment of {{name}}?
withdrawDialog.message: The record is kept as history — attendance and grades are not deleted.

promote.title: Promote students to the next academic year
promote.subtitle: Map each class of the current year to its class in the next year.
promote.hint: Previous enrollments are completed rather than edited, so each year keeps its own record.

empty.title: No enrollments yet
empty.message: Enroll a student into a class to start the academic year.

graduate.title: Graduate the leaving year group?
graduate.message: Every pupil in the exit grade of {{year}} will be marked as graduated and their enrolment closed. They will no longer appear on any roster, register or report card.
graduate.done: The leaving year group has graduated

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.subtitle: The weekly timetable for classes, teachers and rooms

conflicts.title: Scheduling conflict
conflicts.blocked: This period cannot be saved until the conflict is resolved.
conflicts.warningRoom: The room is already in use at this time. Save anyway?
conflicts.none: No conflicts — this slot is free.
conflicts.checkFailed: Could not check this slot. Save to let the server verify it.

schedules.noSelection: Select a class, teacher or room to view its timetable.

empty.title: No timetable yet
empty.message: Add the first period to build the weekly timetable.

dialogs.deleteMessage: {{subject}} on {{day}} at {{time}} will be removed from the timetable.
